description: A curated, reproducible view of frozen F4, F5, F6-IC, root-finding, SAT and reference sessions. Observations stay separate by exact target, configuration, binary and host. This imports historical evidence without rerunning a solver; it is not an exhaustive or globally fastest claim. The IC recipe leaderboard remains the source for admitted whole-pipeline comparisons outside these sessions.
scope: observed single-target, cold solve count-band frontiers within one session and exact workload; not ledger promotions, global records, or cross-host wall rankings

integrity_problems: records file is unbound or its hash mismatches
